To: Training participants
From: Elena Park, Training Coordinator
Subject: Inventory workshop - June 12

Our inventory workshop will take place on Wednesday, June 12, from 9:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. The session has moved from Room A to Room B because the projector in Room A is being repaired.

Please bring your laptop and the stock report attached to this email. Coffee will be available from 8:45 a.m. Participants who want the optional lunch at noon should reply to this email by Monday, June 10.

group.passageText:
Riverside Fitness Centre
Notice to members

Starting July 1, the centre will open at 6:00 a.m. on weekdays, one hour earlier than before. Saturday and Sunday hours will remain 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

The swimming pool will be closed from July 3 to July 5 for cleaning. Members may use the pool at our North Street branch during this period at no additional charge. Bring your membership card to enter that branch.

For questions about the temporary arrangement, contact the reception desk.

questions.content: At what time did the centre previously open on weekdays?
Why will the swimming pool be closed?

options.D: The centre will change its weekend hours.
